convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a quaternion to a 4x4 homogeneous rotation matrix using quat_to_mat
convert_euler_angles_to_rotation_matrix: convert euler angles to a 3x3 rotation matrix with a specified axis ordering like XYZ or ZYZ
compute_homogeneous_transform_from_pose: build a 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrix from position and quaternion using pos_quat_to_hmat
interpolate_quaternions_with_slerp: slerp interpolate between two quaternions at a given fraction using quat_slerp
transform_velocity_or_force_between_fram: transform a 6D twist or wrench between coordinate frames using velocity_transform or force_transform
